content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Breach
content_blocks.text: The Tenant has failed to comply with the terms of the lease agreement as of June 1, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Termination_Date
content_blocks.text: The tenancy shall terminate on July 15, 2024, unless the Tenant cures the breach within 30 days.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Eviction_Process
content_blocks.text: Upon the expiration of the cure period, the Landlord may proceed with the eviction process as provided by law.
